objects.constraint public.departure_handoff_run_:
CHECK (((outcome IS NULL) OR
CASE outcome
    WHEN 'applied'::text THEN ((replacement_booking_id IS NOT NULL) AND (replacement_booking_id <> source_booking_id))
    WHEN 'pending'::text THEN (replacement_booking_id IS NULL)
    WHEN 'ineligible'::text THEN (replacement_booking_id IS NULL)
    WHEN 'processing_failed'::text THEN (replacement_booking_id IS NULL)
    WHEN 'stopped'::text THEN (replacement_booking_id IS NULL)
    ELSE false
END))
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, run_id) REFERENCES departure_handoff_runs(organization_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.constraint public.departure_handoff_runs: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES auth.organization(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (((state IS NULL) OR
CASE state
    WHEN 'running'::text THEN ((finished_at IS NULL) AND (failure_code IS NULL))
    WHEN 'paused'::text THEN ((finished_at IS NULL) AND (failure_code IS NULL))
    WHEN 'stopped'::text THEN ((finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (failure_code IS NULL))
    WHEN 'completed'::text THEN ((finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (failure_code IS NULL))
    WHEN 'failed'::text THEN ((finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (failure_code IS NOT NULL) AND (failure_code = ANY (ARRAY['departed_member_returned'::text, 'authorization_lost'::text, 'run_expired'::text])))
    ELSE false
END))

CHECK ((isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(next_item_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND (next_item_at >= created_at) AND (expires_at > created_at) AND ((finished_at IS NULL) OR (isfinite(finished_at) AND (finished_at >= created_at)))))
objects.index public.departure_handoff_offers.de: CREATE INDEX departure_handoff_offers_run_candidates_idx ON public.departure_handoff_offers USING btree (organization_id, departing_user_id, expires_at, source_booking_id) WHERE (state = 'live'::text)
objects.index public.departure_handoff_runs.depa: CREATE INDEX departure_handoff_runs_due_idx ON public.departure_handoff_runs USING btree (next_item_at, organization_id, id) WHERE (state = 'running'::text)
CREATE INDEX departure_handoff_runs_expiry_idx ON public.departure_handoff_runs USING btree (expires_at, organization_id, id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'paused'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX departure_handoff_runs_one_active ON public.departure_handoff_runs USING btree (organization_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'paused'::text]))
CREATE INDEX departure_handoff_runs_retention_idx ON public.departure_handoff_runs USING btree (finished_at, organization_id, id) WHERE (finished_at IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX departure_handoff_runs_team_created_idx ON public.departure_handoff_runs USING btree (organization_id, created_at DESC)
